record.original_question: Does every irreducible arithmetically Cohen-Macaulay curve in P^4 admit an Artinian reduction that has the strong Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Question 3.3. Do all irreducible arithmetically Cohen-Macaulay curves in P^4 have an Artinian reduction that has the SLP?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work over an algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic zero, and consider the projective space $\mathbb{P}^4 = \mathbb{P}^4_k$. Let $C \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ be an irreducible curve, and let $R = k[x_0,\ldots,x_4]/I_C$ be its homogeneous coordinate ring, where $I_C$ is the saturated homogeneous ideal of $C$. The curve $C$ is called arithmetically Cohen–Macaulay (ACM) if $R$ is a Cohen–Macaulay ring, equivalently if $\mathrm{depth}(R) = \dim(R) = 2$.

Given such an ACM curve, choose a regular sequence of two general linear forms $\ell_1, \ell_2 \in R$; the quotient $A = R/(\ell_1,\ell_2)$ is then a graded Artinian $k$-algebra, called an Artinian reduction of $R$.

A graded Artinian $k$-algebra $A = \bigoplus_{i\ge 0} A_i$ is said to have the Strong Lefschetz Property (SLP) if there exists a linear form $L \in A_1$ such that, for every pair of integers $0 \le i$ and $d \ge 1$, the multiplication map
$$\times L^d : A_i \longrightarrow A_{i+d}$$
has maximal rank (i.e., is either injective or surjective).

Question: Does every irreducible arithmetically Cohen–Macaulay curve $C \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ admit an Artinian reduction $A$ of its homogeneous coordinate ring that has the Strong Lefschetz Property?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this question was located. The literature on Lefschetz properties of Artinian reductions of ACM curves focuses largely on curves in $\mathbb{P}^3$ and on specific constructions; the analogous question for arbitrary irreducible ACM curves in $\mathbb{P}^4$ appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lefschetz Properties in Algebra, Geometry, Topology and Combinatorics (Migliore–Favacchio notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey notes on the Weak and Strong Lefschetz Properties of Artinian reductions of ACM subschemes, focusing primarily on the case of curves in P^3.
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys treat the Lefschetz properties of Artinian reductions of ACM curves but do not resolve the P^4 case.

status_evidence.title: The Geometry of the Weak Lefschetz Property (Migliore)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies WLP/SLP for Artinian reductions arising from ACM curves, mostly in P^3.
status_evidence.claim: Available results target P^3, with the P^4 setting not addressed.
